title: Static prop live qualification on an 8 GB GPU

cases.prompt: A single sturdy three-legged wooden workshop stool with a round worn seat, simple joinery, no moving parts, and neutral studio presentation.
A small circular fieldstone well with a timber roof, fixed iron crank, coiled rope, and weathered mortar, presented as one static game asset.
A single hand-thrown ceramic floor vase with two small loop handles, a cobalt geometric glaze, a stable base, and no surrounding scene.
A sealed science-fiction cargo crate with reinforced corners, two recessed side handles, restrained hazard markings, and a clean rectangular silhouette.
A freestanding wrought-iron oil lantern with four glass panes, a top carry ring, an enclosed unlit wick, and a readable static silhouette.
A closed oak storage barrel with six dark iron hoops, uneven hand-cut staves, one small bung, and no labels or surrounding objects.
A standalone park bench made from five weathered timber slats on two cast-iron supports, with intact feet and no environment around it.
A compact red cast-iron fire hydrant with one domed top, two capped side outlets, a bolted base flange, and chipped municipal paint.
A closed static treasure chest with a curved oak lid, blackened iron straps, a centered key plate, and no visible contents or extra props.
A single blacksmith anvil with a square hardy hole, round pritchel hole, tapered horn, stepped base, and visibly used steel surface.
